camel_example: aliyun alb UpdateLoadBalancerZones --region cn-hangzhou --ZoneMappings.1.EipType Common --ZoneMappings.1.ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-a' --DryRun true --ZoneMappings.1.IntranetAddress '192.168.10.1' --LoadBalancerId 'alb-o9ulmq5hfn68jk0000' --ClientToken '5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF3898' --ZoneMappings.1.VSwitchId 'vsw-bp1rmcrwg3srh1fh80000' --RetainResourceType.1 eip --method POST --force
description_en: Modifies the zone attributes of an Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance
description_zh: 修改应用型负载均衡实例可用区属性
kebab_example: aliyun alb update-load-balancer-zones --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF3898 --dry-run true --load-balancer-id alb-o9ulmq5hfn68jk0000 --zone-mappings IntranetAddress=192.168.10.1 ZoneId=cn-hangzhou-a VSwitchId=vsw-bp1rmcrwg3srh1fh80000 EipType=Common --retain-resource-type eip --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLoadBalancerZones

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request format, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, the corresponding error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): sends a normal request, passes the dry run, and returns an `HTTP_2xx` status code. The operation is then performed to modify the zone attributes of the Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改应用型负载均衡实例可用区属性。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回`HTTP_2xx`状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the public elastic IP address (EIP). Valid values:

Common: elastic IP address (EIP).
Anycast: Anycast elastic IP address (Anycast EIP).

For the regions where ALB supports binding Anycast EIPs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460727.html
fields.help_zh:
公网EIP的类型。取值：

Common：弹性公网IP，简称EIP。
Anycast：任播弹性公网IP，简称Anycast EIP。

ALB支持绑定Anycast EIP的地域，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460727.html
fields.name: eip_type

fields.help_en: The IPv4 private IP address. Specify at least two zones and up to 10 zones
fields.help_zh: IPv4私网地址。至少需要添加2个可用区，最多支持添加10个可用区
fields.name: intranet_address

fields.help_en: The vSwitch that corresponds to the zone. Each zone uses one vSwitch and one subnet by default. You can specify up to 10 zones. If the current region supports two or more zones, specify at least two zones
fields.help_zh: 可用区对应的交换机，每个可用区默认使用一台交换机和一个子网。最多支持添加10个可用区。若当前地域支持2个及以上的可用区，至少需要添加2个可用区
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en: The zone name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189196.html operation to query the zones. You can specify up to 10 zones. If the current region supports two or more zones, specify at least two zones
fields.help_zh: 可用区名称，通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189196.html接口获得。最多支持添加10个可用区。若当前地域支持2个及以上的可用区，至少需要添加2个可用区
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The mappings between zones and vSwitches. You can specify up to 10 zones. If the current region supports two or more zones, specify at least two zones. If specified, the previous zone configuration is replaced
parameters.help_zh: 可用区及交换机映射列表，最多支持指定10个可用区。若当前地域支持2个及以上的可用区，至少需要指定2个可用区。如果指定，则会替换之前的可用区配置
parameters.name: zone_mappings

parameters.help_en: The type of ALB-created resources to retain. When you remove a zone from an Internet-facing ALB instance, you can set this parameter to eip to retain the EIPs that are automatically created and associated by the ALB. Anycast EIPs cannot be retained. EIPs that you manually associated are automatically retained
parameters.help_zh: 需要保留的ALB自动创建并绑定的资源类型。移除公网ALB的可用区时，可设置为eip以保留ALB自动创建并绑定的EIP；Anycast EIP不支持保留，用户自行绑定的EIP会自动保留
parameters.name: retain_resource_type
